how.title: Me pēhea te tahuri
how.step1.title: Kōwhiria tō kōnae
how.step1.text: Pēhia te Kōwhiri kōnae, tōia rānei ngā kōnae ki te pouaka i runga ake. Kotahi te kōnae, he maha rānei i te wā kotahi.

how.step2.text: Kōwhiria te hōputu ūnga mō ia kōnae, kātahi ka pēhi i te Tahuri.

how.step3.text: Ka oti ana, pēhia te Tikiake hei tiaki i te kōnae ki tō pūrere.
formats.title: Ngā hōputu e tautokona ana
formats.lead: He rau ngā huinga tahuritanga mō ngā momo kōnae noa katoa:
faq.title: Ngā pātai auau
faq.q1: He kore utu a I Need Convert?
faq.a1: Āe, he kore utu katoa. Kāore he hiahia ki te rēhita, ki te takiuru, ki tētahi taupānga rānei.
faq.q2: Ka tukuatu ōku kōnae ki tētahi tūmau?
faq.a2: Kāo. Ka mahia ia tahuritanga i tō pūtirotiro tonu, nō reira kāore rawa ō kōnae e wehe atu i tō pūrere. Koia hoki te take he tere, he tūmataiti hoki.
faq.q3: Ko ēhea hōputu ka taea te tahuri?
faq.a3: Ngā whakaahua (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, ICO, SVG, TIFF, AVIF), ataata (MP4, WEBM, MOV, MKV, AVI, me ētahi atu), oro (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OPUS), tuhinga (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML), ripanga (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV), raraunga (JSON, YAML, XML) me ngā pūranga ZIP. Ka taea tonu te kōpeke i ētahi atu kōnae ki te ZIP, te huri rānei ki te Base64.
faq.q4: He aha e roa ai te tahuri ataata?
faq.a4: Ka tukatukahia te ataata e tētahi pūkaha tahuri i roto i tō pūtirotiro, nō reira ka whakawhirinaki te tere ki tō pūrere. Ki te huri anake te pouaka (hei tauira MP4 ki MKV), ka tāruatia e mātou te rerenga ataata me te kore e whakawaehere anō, nō reira he tata tonu ki te inamata.
faq.q5: Me pēhea taku huri i tētahi PDF hei whakaahua?
faq.a5: Kōwhiria he kōnae PDF, kātahi ka kōwhiri i te PNG, i te JPG rānei. Ka huri ia whārangi hei whakaahua kotahi, ā, ka taea e koe te tikiake katoa i te wā kotahi hei ZIP.
faq.a6: Kāore i a mātou. Ko te tepe anake ko te pūmahara o tō pūrere. Mō ngā ataata neke atu i te 1–2 GB, he pai ake te rorohiko.
